tpl: Can switch between the default state and the following state: Attack range -1, boomerang projectiles deal {0} ATK as Physical damage, and repeatedly bounce between enemies (up to 3 bounces)

Deals {0} ATK as Physical damage per attack and Slows targets for 1 second. Projectiles will briefly pass through enemies after striking them, then return; all enemies hit during the return take {1} ATK as Physical damage

Throws 3 projectiles (each dealing {0} ATK as Physical damage) per attack; whenever all projectiles return, up to 3 enemies in the 8 tiles surrounding Narantuya take {1} ATK as Physical damage and are Slowed for 1 second
